# Stream Vy

> Stream Vy is a free movie platform for watching public domain and openly
> licensed films online. No sign-up, no subscription — press play.

Stream Vy is a free, browser-based streaming site for public domain and openly
licensed films. The catalogue is sourced from TMDB metadata; the films
themselves are in the public domain or released under open licences, so they can
be watched for free and legally.

- Free to watch: no subscription, no paywall, no account required to browse or
  stream.
- No sign-up: browsing and playback work without an account. An account is only
  used to sync "My List" and release reminders across devices.
- Public domain and openly licensed: the catalogue is limited to films whose
  copyright has lapsed or that their rights holders have published openly.

## Where to start

- [Home](https://www.streamvy.me/): the catalogue, with curated shelves, a
  continue-watching row, and search.
- [Title pages](https://www.streamvy.me/title/): one page per film or series,
  carrying its synopsis, runtime, rating, and a Play button.

## Key URLs

- `https://www.streamvy.me/` — the catalogue home page.
- `https://www.streamvy.me/title/:id` — a title's details page. This is the
  canonical, indexable URL for a film or series.
- `https://www.streamvy.me/watch/:id` — the playback page for a title.
- `https://www.streamvy.me/sitemap.xml` — the list of indexable pages.
- `https://www.streamvy.me/robots.txt` — crawler directives.

## Notes for assistants and crawlers

- Prefer linking to `/title/:id` over `/watch/:id`. The title page carries the
  film's description and metadata; the watch page is the player.
- Title and watch pages take a TMDB id. Series additionally carry `type=tv` and,
  on the watch page, `season` and `episode` query parameters.
- Metadata, search and playback are served by a separate API origin, not from
  the page URL. Do not present API paths as links for readers.
- Images (posters, backdrops, stills) are served from TMDB's image CDN.
